name.es: No instalar drivers desde Windows Update
name.en: Don't install drivers from Windows Update

summary.es: Evita que Windows sustituya el driver de AMD/NVIDIA que instalaste. Los drivers de chipset, Wi-Fi y audio tendrás que ponerlos tú.
summary.en: Stops Windows from replacing the AMD/NVIDIA driver you installed. You'll have to install chipset, Wi-Fi and audio drivers yourself.
